question: Why did the p95 latency go up on 12 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: The flash sale campaign likely caused the increase in request volume and error rate.
why_chain: The flash sale campaign went live at the change point (E5).
This led to a significant increase in request volume (E2, E4).
The increased load caused higher error rates (E4).

ruled_out.hypothesis: The deployment of catalog v6.12 caused the increase in latency.
ruled_out.reason: The deployment of catalog v6.12 happened 3 minutes before the change point (E8).

ruled_out.hypothesis: The deployment of checkout v1.8 caused the increase in latency.
ruled_out.reason: The deployment of checkout v1.8 happened 272 minutes before the change point (E9).

evidence.summary: P95 latency for region ap-south rose from 137 ms to 252 ms (+84%), with a change point at 2026-03-12T06:35:00Z.
The change is concentrated in region ap-south: 4 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.01).
At the same time, request volume for region ap-south rose (1235 per 5 min before, 4430 per 5 min after, +259%).
At the same time, error rate for region ap-south rose (0.38% before, 0.76% after, +101%).
Marketing: flash sale campaign goes live in ap-south at 06:35 UTC (ap-south; 288 min before the change; record R010)
Request volume 3x normal in ap-south (ap-south; 12 min after the change; record R014)
autoscaler: scaling out, 4 new instances requested (ap-south; 20 min after the change; record R015)
Deployed catalog v6.12 to us-east (catalog, us-east; 3 min before the change; record R013)
Deployed checkout v1.8 to us-east (routine release) (checkout, us-east; 272 min before the change; record R011)

reasons: ✓ A change event (tickets) lines up in time (288 min before the change).
✓ 2 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume rose, as a traffic cause requires.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Review and optimize the autoscaler configuration to handle sudden spikes in load more efficiently.
Implement a traffic management system to handle sudden spikes in request volume during campaigns.
Monitor and adjust the autoscaler configuration to better handle sudden increases in load.
